result.title: Self-Upgrading Embodied Agents
result.summary: An embodied agent built on a language model goes to work with the weights it was given and keeps them for life. To get better, it needs more training, or reflection, memory, search or prompts that cost every step and are lost when the task changes. Editing weights by reasoning, weight-space programming, could end this, but has stayed with models that only reason or relied on a far larger commercial model. We introduce the self-upgrading embodied agent, to our knowledge the first that learns from its own experience by upgrading its own weights on the job, between its tasks, with no training, no gradient, no reward model, no second model, no test-time scaling and no harness or prompt engineering. By day a 27B agent works in a household environment. At night it reads its record, finds many of its steps wasted on replies that reach the token limit before any action, traces the habit to one direction in its hidden states, and rewrites one tensor of its weights. An agent that rewrites itself must first never break itself, so it is its own examiner: it tests every change against its unchanged self on practice tasks and keeps only what holds. When an edit holds, the next day it is a better agent, at the same cost per step: over thousands of held-out episodes, 48 fresh seeds a task, its one kept edit makes it complete significantly more tasks, in fewer steps, with fewer wasted and fewer tokens. This self-improvement is multi-round, stable and continual: through the nights that follow, the upgrade holds, without collapse. Of four sizes of its family, only the 27B agent does this. From here on, an embodied agent need not keep training and inference apart: as it works, it gathers its own experience and upgrades itself, with no separate pre-training or post-training and no human intervention. We believe this opens lifelong continual learning for robots: stable, continual, recursive self-improvement.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出可自我升级的具身智能体：夜间读取自身任务记录，将常因触及 token 上限而未及时行动的浪费行为定位到隐状态中的某一方向，据此无梯度地改写单个权重张量，并以「不改动自身」为准则在练习题上自测筛选每次修改，另一个白天保持每步成本不变地提升任务完成率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用隐状态方向定位行为习惯、再修改内部参数」的线索，可供核查 LVR 中内部状态诊断与停止/行动决策（STOP）的因果干预与改动验证机制；但对象是具身家务智能体与权重编辑，未涉及视觉细节保留与 latent 推理轨迹，迁移需阅读原文。
